name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
summary: Shanghai AI Laboratory is a [research institution in Shanghai, China](https://www.shlab.org.cn/aboutus). It makes the InternLM language models and the InternVL multimodal models.

incidents.title: Flaw in Shanghai AI Lab's MindSearch Agent Lets Attackers Run Code Through Its Planner
incidents.summary: [CVE-2026-105135](https://nki.gov.hu/figyelmeztetesek/serulekenysegek/cve-2026-105135/), published on 4 October 2026, describes a flaw in version 0.1.0 of MindSearch, Shanghai AI Laboratory's open-source search agent, that lets a remote attacker inject code through its planner agent. According to the record, the exploit is public and the vendor did not respond when it was contacted.
incidents.description: [A CVE record](https://nki.gov.hu/figyelmeztetesek/serulekenysegek/cve-2026-105135/) describes a flaw in version 0.1.0 of MindSearch, the open-source search agent from Shanghai AI Laboratory. [According to a public exploit](https://vuln.management/advisories/cve-2026-105135-mindsearch/), a remote request can make the planner model write attacker code, and the server runs this code without a sandbox. The record says that the vendor did not reply when contacted.
